AI_SHADOWS.TITLE: AI Analysis
AI_SHADOWS.DESCRIPTION: Quality observers that audit conversations (human and AI) and feed the analysis.
AI_SHADOWS.EMPTY: No analysts created. Create one to audit your conversations.

FORM.NAME: Nome
FORM.NAME_REQUIRED: Give this analyst a name before saving.
FORM.INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOLDER: What the analyst should watch for and hold conversations to (e.g. was a duplicate bill offered? was the reply courteous? was any price or deadline wrong?).
FORM.SUGGESTIONS_HINT: Click the suggestions below or type straight into the field to add evaluation instructions.

SUGGESTIONS.UNANSWERED: Point out customer questions that went unanswered.
SUGGESTIONS.ERRORS: Flag errors or incorrect information given during the conversation.
SUGGESTIONS.LOW_CONFIDENCE: Identify vague replies or ones given with low confidence.
SUGGESTIONS.KNOWLEDGE_GAPS: Point out subjects with no coverage in the knowledge base.
SUGGESTIONS.TOOLS_MISSING: Note when a tool or integration was missing to resolve the request.
SUGGESTIONS.RECURRING: Highlight themes or problems that keep coming up in conversations.
